title: I.R. Coelho v. State of Tamil Nadu

content.caseIdentity: I.R. Coelho v. State of Tamil Nadu, (2007) 2 SCC 1
content.holding: A law inserted in the Ninth Schedule after 24 April 1973 can be struck down if it damages the basic structure, especially the golden triangle of Articles 14, 19 and 21.
content.relevance: Authoritative 9-judge bench decision on the Ninth Schedule.
